details.description: Kimi K2.5 is Moonshot AI's agentic chat model, built via continual pretraining of Kimi K2 on roughly 15 trillion additional image-and-text tokens, on the same 1-trillion-parameter, 32-billion-activated mixture-of-experts architecture. Moonshot's Hugging Face card, dated January 29, 2026, describes it as natively multimodal -- unifying vision and text, thinking and non-thinking modes, and single- and multi-agent execution -- and adds an 'Agent Swarm' feature that decomposes a task into parallel sub-tasks run by dynamically instantiated sub-agents. It is released under a Modified MIT License. Moonshot's own later Kimi K2.6 model card reports higher scores than K2.5 on several agentic benchmarks.
advantages: Scores 96.1% on AIME 2025, per Moonshot's model card.
Scores 87.6% on GPQA-Diamond, per Moonshot's model card.
Scores 76.8% on SWE-bench Verified, per Moonshot's model card.
Scores 85.0% on LiveCodeBench v6, per Moonshot's model card.
Scores 78.5% on MMMU-Pro, a multimodal reasoning benchmark, per Moonshot's model card.
disadvantages: Superseded within Moonshot's own lineup by the later Kimi K2.6 release, whose model card reports higher scores than K2.5 on SWE-Bench Pro (58.6 vs 50.7) and Humanity's Last Exam with tools (54.0 vs 50.2).
Moonshot's own API platform lists 'kimi-k2.5' as discontinued since August 31, 2026, directing users to the newer Kimi K3 model, per Moonshot's Model List page.
use_cases: Vision-based code generation from UI designs and visual specifications.
Multi-step tool calling and interleaved reasoning for autonomous agent tasks.
Cross-modal reasoning over combined image-and-text input.
Large multi-agent workflows via Agent Swarm orchestration.

notes: The canonical id 'kimi-k2p5' is Fireworks' id for this model; Fireworks' own model page for accounts/fireworks/models/kimi-k2p5 identifies it as Moonshot AI's Kimi K2.5. This is a separate target from the 'kimi-k2.5' slug elsewhere in this catalog batch -- both describe the same underlying model under different canonical ids, so the write-ups may read as near-duplicates. Catalog's modality for this target is text_input/text_output only, but Moonshot's own model card and Fireworks' hosted page both describe Kimi K2.5 as natively multimodal with image and video input; kept the catalog's text-only modality as authoritative and did not claim image input as a capability of this specific route, per instructions -- worth checking whether this Fireworks deployment truly lacks vision input or the catalog fact is stale. Could not confirm an exact day-level release date beyond the Hugging Face card's own 'January 29, 2026' listing (Fireworks' page separately showed 'Ready' status as of January 27, 2026). Removed an original 'up to 100 self-orchestrated sub-agents' Agent Swarm claim: neither the Hugging Face card nor the GitHub repo states a general sub-agent cap -- the only '100' figure on the card is 'sub-agents max 100 steps', a per-agent step limit used in the BrowseComp/WideSearch Swarm-Mode eval configs, not a swarm-size claim. Moonshot's own current API docs (platform.kimi.ai/docs/models) separately list 'kimi-k2.5' among models discontinued since August 31, 2026, recommending Kimi K3 (not K2.6); this governs Moonshot's own first-party API only, and the open-weight checkpoint remains independently servable through the Fireworks route this catalog target actually uses, so I kept the existing K2.6-supersession framing and added this as a second, more current disadvantage rather than replacing it.
